frequency_question: How often do CCyB activations above 0% occur given observable credit-to-GDP gap or systemic vulnerability signals over a multi-year horizon?
membership_rule: Includes any Basel Committee member jurisdiction raising the CCyB from 0% to a positive rate. Excludes maintaining an already positive rate or passive expirations.
provenance_note: 7 cases named, 15 claimed via skeleton x multiplier (2.1x)
coverage_note: 15 major jurisdictions tracked; 6 instances of active deployment from zero.
known_gaps: Excludes smaller emerging market jurisdictions implementing Basel III standards.
skeleton: Major G20 financial jurisdictions establishing or raising a dormant CCyB above 0% during non-crisis expansionary credit cycles over the last decade.
multiplier: 15 advanced economy central banks observed across 10 years; approximately 6 distinct jurisdictions activated or raised CCyB above zero following accumulation signals.
validity_reason: Macroprudential frameworks and Basel III implementation cycles remain stable over medium-term horizons.
